definition.def: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.
examples: I inferred from what she said that you have not been well. [VERB that]
By measuring the motion of the galaxies in a cluster, astronomers can infer the cluster's mass. [VERB noun]

definition.def: Some people use infer to mean 'imply', but many people consider this use to be incorrect.
examples: The police inferred that they found her behaviour rather suspicious. [VERB that]
